doc.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023

title: Royalty checks
summary: Royalty checks from his writing keep shrinking but still arrive.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Did you ever get, or do you ever get checks in the mail for things that you have written?

Yeah. Sure. But you know what? They are royalty checks and after 30 years if you don’t have a really tremendous smash they get smaller and smaller and smaller and smaller until they’re not worth the paper that they’re — you know, they’re small right now. You can’t buy a pack of cigarettes, even if you smoked you can’t buy a pack of cigarettes.
Yeah the checks get smaller and the prices are going up.
Yeah. Yeah. Well that’s right, that hits the nail right on the head. Yes — I’m sorry — yes I still get royalty checks for writing and publishing too.
